dog.description_text:
Pop Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop up crate. My adoption fee is waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

Meet Knox!
Knox was found as a stray, and he's ready to find a family to call his own! This curious guy loves sniffing around and checking out his surroundings, and he's still getting comfortable with all the new experiences at ACC. He's got plenty to keep him busy and is looking for someone who can help him channel his enthusiasm into fun adventures and new skills.

My Ideal Home
Knox would love an active home where he can enjoy daily walks, explore new places, and have plenty of opportunities to use his brain. Food puzzles, long lasting chews, and fun training games will help keep him happily occupied. He's still learning his leash manners, so a patient person who enjoys helping a dog learn and grow would be a great match for him.

Good with Other Pets?
Knox's history with other dogs is unknown, but he recently spent time with another dog and eventually joined in some back and forth play. The interaction took a little time to get comfortable, so any introductions with resident pets should be slow, thoughtful, and supervised.

Good with Kids?
Knox would do best in a home without children under 13. He can get excited and jump up during interactions, so a home with older family members who can give him space and help him practice calmer greetings would be a better fit.

Things to Know
Knox can be easily distracted on walks and may jump or try to grab his leash when he gets excited. Positive reinforcement training, patience, and consistency will help him learn more comfortable ways to manage that energy. He's still learning about the world around him, and with the right person to guide him, Knox can keep building confidence and working toward becoming a wonderful companion.
dog.name: Knox
